names: Сде-Дов (שדה דב); «район Сде-Дов» (название сайта: Район Сде-Дов). Аэропорт Дов Хоз. Комплексы: Эшколь (квартал Эшколь, как на карте сайта), Центр района, Север района. Проекты латиницей, как их пишут застройщики: Rainbow Tel Aviv (Israel Canada), FIRST (Hagag Group), ASHIRA (Avisror Moshe & Sons), DIMRI YAMA (Y.H. Dimri; архитектор Рани Зис, интерьеры Kelly Hoppen), ZOHI, GINDI VOGUE (Gindi Holdings), UTOPIA (Nahmias Group), Mediterranean Towers (מגדלי הים התיכון, резиденция для пожилых). Генподрядчик Ashtrom. Места: Цукей-Авив, улица Пропес, Неве-Ям, Тохнит Ламед (תכנית ל׳), улица Леви Эшколь, Кохав ха-Цафон, комплекс Рединг, улица Шай Агнон, парк Яркон, Ибн Гвироль, Рамат-Авив (так ищут: «рамат авив», 880 в месяц), Рамат-Авив Гимель, Парк Цамерет, Зелёная линия легкорельсового трамвая. Органы: Земельное управление Израиля (Рами), окружная комиссия Тель-Авива, местная комиссия Тель-Авива-Яффо, муниципалитет Тель-Авива-Яффо. Законы: закон о продаже (квартир) и гарантия по закону о продаже. Термины: налог на покупку (мас рехиша), налог на улучшение (hetel hashbaha), плата за управление (дмей ниуль), продажа на этапе котлована (пресейл), счёт банковского сопровождения.
keywords_monthly: цены на квартиры в тель авиве
сде дов тель авив / сде дов квартиры / район сде дов / новостройки тель авив
serp: Russian SERP not run (volumes near zero; the Kikar HaMedina Russian research of 30.9.2026 found buying intent around Israel and Tel Aviv far larger than any place name). Typical questions: сколько стоит квартира, цена за метр, налог на покупку, ипотека для нерезидентов, когда заселение.
audience: Русскоязычные израильтяне (знают слова салон, маклер, мас рехиша) и покупатели из-за границы. Им важны цена, цена квадратного метра, налоги, сроки и надёжность застройщика.
culture: Объяснить один раз израильский счёт комнат («4 комнаты: салон и три спальни») и гарантию по закону о продаже. Тон уверенный и тёплый, без канцелярита. Покупка через адвоката по доверенности возможна, без новых цифр.
typography: Десятичная запятая (9,45 млн ₪), неразрывный пробел между тысячами (83 000 ₪), даты 12.03.2020 или «12 марта 2020 года», кавычки «ёлочки»; без длинного (—) и среднего (–) тире: предложения строятся без тире.
units: м² и ₪. Без долларов и гектаров; дунам можно объяснить один раз (1 дунам = 1 000 м²).
banned: интерфейс · демо · модель (в смысле 3D) · движок · слой · прототип · симуляция · технология · «система» · «платформа» · цифровой опыт · 3D · Атлас · скоро · «бесплатная консультация» · любые названия источников и СМИ (Википедия, Globes, Calcalist, Ynet, Маарив, Psagot...) · стоит отметить · важно понимать · в заключение · уникальный шанс

claims.claim: The Israeli room count includes the living room: '4 rooms' = a living room and 3 bedrooms; a '1-room' unit is a studio.
claims.write_as: Explain once for a foreign reader; never convert to bedrooms in a table.

claims.claim: A dunam (the Israeli land unit) is 1,000 m2.
claims.write_as: Allowed once, to explain the unit. No other conversions (no sq ft, no acres, no hectares, no dollars or euros).

claims.claim: Quarters: 'the first quarter of 2026' = January to March 2026 (Q1, 1-3.2026).
claims.write_as: 'Q1 2026' or 'the first quarter of 2026'. Keep the year.

claims.claim: The Sde Dov quarter (rova), on the site of the former airfield in north-west Tel Aviv-Yafo, is planned for about 16,000 apartments ('16 thousand') in three compounds: Eshkol (south-east), the Centre and the North.
claims.conflict: '15,000-20,000 units' (an English guide) is not the plan: never use it.
claims.write_as: 'about 16,000 apartments planned'. Never a delivery date for the whole quarter.

claims.claim: A survey of the developers' annual reports published in April 2026: about 1,280 apartments sold in the quarter so far; their average price about ₪83,000 per m2; a 4-room apartment sold for about ₪9.45 million on average.
claims.conflict: An older page figure 'about 81,000' and an average 'about 7 million per deal' have no source: never use them.
claims.write_as: 'about ₪83,000 per m2' (an average of sold units, not an asking price).

claims.claim: In 2026 most projects in the quarter sell at about ₪70,000 per m2.
Per the developers' 2025 reports, the sales averages of the projects in the Eshkol compound ranged from about ₪63,400 to about ₪82,600 per m2, VAT included.
The largest deal published in the quarter: an apartment of about 390 m2 with a balcony of about 200 m2 on floor 38 of a tower in the Central compound, sold in December 2025 for more than ₪42 million.
claims.conflict: '43.75 million for 508 m2' had no source: never use it.

claims.claim: In December 2025 three apartments on floors 38, 39 and 43 of a tower facing the sea sold for about ₪107,700 to ₪119,200 per m2 of built area (balconies not counted).
March 2026: two deals for 5-room apartments of 132 m2 on floor 9 in one project, ₪7.16 to ₪7.57 million, about ₪54,200 to ₪57,300 per m2 ('deals of 54,000-57,000 per m2').
The range of deals in the April 2026 survey: about ₪60,200 to ₪138,000 per m2.
Tel Aviv-Yafo: the median of deals in the two years to October 2025 (October 2023 to October 2025) was ₪52,856 per m2.
claims.write_as: A median of deals, not an average.

claims.claim: In one project in the quarter the average rose from about ₪64,700 per m2 in the first quarter of 2026 to about ₪81,600 per m2 in the eight deals after it (VAT included).
In June 2026 one developer valued its unsold apartments at about ₪73,200 per m2 incl. VAT, below its 2025 deals average of about ₪82,500.
The official (list) prices in the projects: ₪75,000 to ₪85,000 per m2 before financing benefits.
claims.write_as: List prices before financing benefits, not deals.

claims.claim: Per one developer in the quarter (December 2025), selected apartments sold at ₪90,000 to ₪100,000 per m2.
2 rooms: recent deals in one Eshkol project ₪2.8 to ₪3.1 million (May 2026); in its presale ₪2.4 to ₪2.7 million. Another 2-room deal: 54 m2, floor 9, ₪3.665 million, about ₪67,900 per m2 (2026).
3 rooms of 82-83 m2: recent deals in the same Eshkol project ₪4.6 to ₪4.8 million (May 2026).
4-5 rooms of 104-126 m2 on floors 10-13, four deals: ₪6.49 to ₪7.73 million, about ₪61,300 to ₪62,800 per m2 (2026).
5 rooms of 139.7 m2 on floor 18 (of 20), on one project's price list: ₪11.954 million, about ₪85,600 per m2 (October 2025); in round words 'up to ₪11.95 million on one price list'.
claims.write_as: A price-list (asking) price, not a deal.

claims.claim: Summaries of the published deals and price lists: 2-room apartments sold in 2026 for about ₪2.8 to ₪3.7 million; 5-room apartments of 126-132 m2 sold in 2026 for about ₪7.2 to ₪7.7 million; 5 rooms in deals and price lists from about ₪7.2 to about ₪12 million; 4 and 5 rooms about ₪6.5 to ₪12 million.
claims.write_as: Ranges as written in the Hebrew; no new averages.

claims.claim: A 1-room apartment of 32 m2 on floor 4 of one of the towers sold in July 2023 for ₪3.1 million.
claims.conflict: '2.3 million for 32 m2' had no source: never use it.

claims.claim: FIRST (Hagag Group, Central compound): by July 2025, about 94 apartments plus 8 more agreements were marketed for about ₪853 million, about ₪8.4 million per apartment on average; its 2025 average about ₪75,500 per m2.
Eshkol: in one project the recent deals were at ₪60,000 to ₪62,000 per m2 (May 2026); the Centre and the North have no separate published average.
Ramat Aviv: recent deals average about ₪55,000 per m2 (June 2026); Ramat Aviv Gimel about ₪51,000 to ₪53,000 per m2 (August 2026). Park Tzameret: depends on the tower and the floor (no figure).
claims.conflict: 'Park Tzameret 90,000-120,000' had no source: never use it.

claims.claim: In March 2025 the developer Yigal Dimri estimated that in a decade or two prices in the quarter could reach ₪150,000 per m2: a very optimistic forecast against today's average of about ₪83,000.
Counts in the page's own words: four main price factors; three markets (small apartments, family apartments, premium); at least ten parameters for comparing two apartments.
